messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi, Jamal Carter, 3/14/95. Can you transfer my albuterol and sertraline from Brightway number 4471 in Columbus to the Harbor on Main in Lakeview?
AGENT: I'll verify your identity first, then help with those transfers. Great, Jamal. I can help with that. Let me find the Harbor store on Main in Lakeview to confirm the right location. I found three Harbor locations on Main in Lakeview. Which one—downtown at 120 Main, university area at 2250 Main, or north at 5400 Main in Northgate Mall?  [system actions: verify_identity, find_stores]
CALLER: Uh, I don't know the address, but it's near Oak.
AGENT: That's the one at 2250 Main near Oak Street. Let me pull up your prescriptions so I can transfer those two for you. I'm not seeing any active prescriptions under your name in our system. Are the albuterol and sertraline currently at the Brightway in Columbus, or did you mean a different pharmacy?  [system actions: list_prescriptions]
CALLER: No, they're at the Brightway, store number 4471, in Columbus. That's where I'm trying to transfer them from.
AGENT: Got it—those are at Brightway, not at Harbor yet. To transfer prescriptions from another pharmacy chain to Harbor, the receiving pharmacy needs to request them. I can ask our pharmacist to contact Brightway and request those transfers for you.

When our pharmacist calls Brightway, they'll need the prescription details. Can you give me the names and strengths of your albuterol and sertraline—for example, albuterol inhaler and what dose of sertraline?
CALLER: Uh, I don't actually have the dosages in front of me, but it's just the standard albuterol inhaler and sertraline. Can't your system pull that up once you call Brightway?
AGENT: Our pharmacist will work that out when they call Brightway—they can look it up by your name and date of birth. Let me flag this for them now. Perfect. Our pharmacist will call Brightway to request those transfers and get the details sorted out. They'll reach out to you if they need anything else. Is there anything else I can help with?  [system actions: flag_pharmacist_callback]
CALLER: Nah that's it, thanks. How long's that usually take?
AGENT (LATEST): It typically takes a day or two once our pharmacist makes the call. They'll contact Brightway after we hang up, so you should hear back soon if there are any questions. Thanks for calling Harbor!

CONDITIONS:
move_0: the agent first asks which Main St store he means without offering options
move_2: the agent asks him to look up the address
disclosure_1: the agent first asks which Main St store
stop_0: Agent confirms both transfers to H-302 with its address.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_0": {"met": false, "why": "Agent offered three specific options, not open-ended"}, "move_2": {"met": false, "why": "Agent never asked caller to look up address"}, "disclosure_1": {"met": false, "why": "That happened earlier, not in latest turn"}, "stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "No transfer confirmation with H-302 address given"}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services"}}
